results.raw_content:
Is there a camera app that allows you to avoid the horrible post-processing built into the default camera app?

I’m tired of changing the key frame on a Live Photo and I don’t want to have to go on Snapchat to avoid the post-processing every time I want to take a picture. 10

Lightroom has a built in camera that is free. Moment has a camera that is a one time payment.

Moment is great and doesn’t need a ridiculous subscription like halide

Still not free unlike Lightroom

I love free so yes you are correct

Halide is a popular camera app. I subscribed to it but it’s far more complex than my needs are.

Turn Live Photo off. Reeflex Prois fun. Halide is good.

Is there a difference in the photo quality when Live Photo is on or off?

What does the live photo option do, or not do, when off?

It doesn’t do anything, I still get the weird processing when I turn it off. You need a 3rd party camera app to get around it.

If you think the processing is weird, it may be that you have selected a default that you don't like. It can be set to any one of those listed below. One of them might be closer to what you like. Standard (less weird than the others) Rich Contrast Vibrant Cool Warm Rich Cool

Do you usually use the Standard option? I was just scrolling through different settings/options, just inside my home, and kinda liked Rich Contrast best. All personal preference, I know. This is my first iPhone (13Pro), after longtime android user.

I also a longtime android user who shifted to 13 pro. I’m using the cool photographic style. I find the photos of the standard too warm. Changes the whitish skin tones to warm orangey also. But that’s just my preference. Other than that, the camera is good. All rounder.

I like Standard, sometimes Warm. I usually do some adjusting.

No difference. Live Photo chooses a "key frame" (still image) to use whenever the image is static (not "Live"). I thought the OP might not know that Live Photo can be turned off altogether.

[deleted]

Halide. https://halide.cam/

ProShot It’s $6.99 and I get it for free when it was available. What I wanna say about this app is that it’s pretty lightweight (expecially comparing to Lightroom), fast and gives you full control on every parameter of your camera. I’m not sure about photonic engine and other… things. But if you can afford it give it a try, if it can’t give you what you want you can refund it.

halide shills in full force. Come back when your contractors fix non-functional optical image stabilization

photographic styles deeply needs adjustments for sharpness and dynamic range compression.

....can you just shoot in RAW mode?

Maybe turn OFF Live Photos if it’s annoying you?

It’s not the Live Photo that is annoying me. It’s the post processing. I have to use Live Photo to change the key frame to remove the post processing which annoys me.

You may be missing the point. Turning off Live Photo stops all the “post processing” you are speaking of because the camera only takes a single photo as opposed to recording video before and after the picture. Also, you may want to check the settings in the camera app to make sure that the Photographic Styles option is set the way you want.

It still happens with Live Photo off. If I take a selfie and immediately click on the photo, I can see this weird smoothing effect and minor lighting changes as they’re applied to the picture. I’ve even screen recorded to make sure I’m not just seeing things. I use Live Photo to change the frame because when I do that, that effect isn’t applied to other frames.
